boards.title: 10 Blocks Off Campus, One Reason Each
boards.description: Ten named destinations on or immediately beside the Tennyson Street corridor, which the local business association defines from 38th to 46th avenues.

cards.title: Historic stage and current programs
cards.subtitle: Tennyson Street corridor — beside W. 38th Avenue
cards.notes: Check the theatre’s program calendar before heading over; its site lists tours, film screenings, concerts, and other community events.
cards.short_summary: A restored 1891 theatre with a current event calendar.
cards.evidence_claim: Historic Elitch Theatre identifies its location at 4600 W. 37th Place and says it now hosts movie nights, tours, and community events.
cards.access_notes: Program availability and admission vary; consult the venue calendar before visiting.

cards.title: A civic-art stop at 41st
cards.subtitle: Tennyson Street corridor — corner of 41st Avenue
cards.notes: Pause at the seat wall to look at its colorful designs and labor-rights quotations, then continue along the Tennyson corridor.
cards.short_summary: A small park marked by public artwork and quotations.
cards.evidence_claim: The Cultural Landscape Foundation places César E. Chávez Park at 41st Avenue and Tennyson Street and describes its decorated seat wall and quotations.
cards.source_title: César E. Chávez Park | The Cultural Landscape Foundation
cards.access_notes: Outdoor public-space access may be affected by weather or programmed events.

cards.title: Handcrafted ice cream on 39th
cards.subtitle: Tennyson Street corridor — 3977 Tennyson Street
cards.notes: Use the shop’s location page to confirm the Berkeley counter, then choose from its current ice-cream offerings or a flight.
cards.short_summary: A Berkeley scoop shop with ice cream and flights.
cards.evidence_claim: High Point Creamery lists its Berkeley shop at 3977 Tennyson Street and describes scoop-shop service and ice cream flights.
cards.access_notes: The official site lists Berkeley hours as noon–10 p.m. daily; confirm before travel.

cards.title: Meet adoptable rescue cats
cards.subtitle: Tennyson Street corridor — 3929 Tennyson Street
cards.notes: Reserve a visit if you want café time with the adoptable cats; review the posted animal-safety rules before arriving.
cards.short_summary: A cat café partnered with Denver Cat Rescue.
cards.evidence_claim: Denver Cat Company says its 3929 Tennyson Street café provides an interactive space to meet adoptable cats from Denver Cat Rescue.
cards.access_notes: The official site states visits cost $15 and lists hours; reservations are available.

cards.title: Browse new and used outdoor gear
cards.subtitle: Tennyson Street corridor — 3936 Tennyson Street
cards.notes: Browse the shop’s used and new outdoor selection, and ask staff about the current rental options if you need seasonal gear.
cards.short_summary: An outdoor shop carrying both used and new gear.
cards.evidence_claim: FERAL identifies its Denver shop at 3936 Tennyson Street and says its in-store assortment includes used and new outdoor gear and apparel.
cards.access_notes: Officially listed daily hours are 10 a.m.–8 p.m.; parking is limited to 90 minutes.

cards.title: Local-maker gift shelves
cards.subtitle: Tennyson Street corridor — 4020 Tennyson Street
cards.notes: Look through the mix of handmade gifts, clothing, jewelry, and accessories; the business directory identifies more than 50 local artists.
cards.short_summary: A gift shop featuring handmade items and local artists.
cards.evidence_claim: Visit Denver’s business guide lists Jolly Goods at 4020 Tennyson Street and describes handmade items, clothing, jewelry, gifts, and work from more than 50 local artists.
cards.source_title: Mile High City Businesses | Visit Denver
cards.access_notes: Retail inventory and hours can change; verify directly before making a special trip.

cards.title: Home and pantry goods at 42nd
cards.subtitle: Tennyson Street corridor — 4234 Tennyson Street
cards.notes: Browse the storefront’s home décor, kitchenware, pantry goods, gifts, children’s goods, and wellness items at your own pace.
cards.short_summary: A neighborhood mercantile for home, pantry, and gift goods.
cards.evidence_claim: Miller Lane Mercantile lists its 4234 Tennyson Street storefront and describes its home décor, kitchenware, pantry, gift, children’s, and wellness assortment.
cards.access_notes: Official hours vary by day; the storefront page provides the current schedule.

cards.title: A Tennyson biscuit counter
cards.subtitle: Tennyson Street corridor — 4275 Tennyson Street
cards.notes: Use the location page to check the current waitlist or pickup options before stopping for the biscuit-focused menu at this address.
cards.short_summary: A Tennyson location serving Denver Biscuit Company’s menu.
cards.evidence_claim: Atomic Cowboy lists Denver Biscuit Company among the concepts served at its 4275 Tennyson Street Denver location.
cards.access_notes: The location page lists daily operating hours and pickup options; verify before visiting.

cards.title: Coffee and books near 44th
cards.subtitle: Tennyson Street corridor — 4418 Tennyson Street
cards.notes: Plan a daytime coffee-and-reading stop, and check the contact page for the current daily hours before walking over.
cards.short_summary: A Tennyson storefront combining coffee service and books.
cards.evidence_claim: Tenn Street Coffee & Books lists its address as 4418 Tennyson Street, Denver, and publishes daily hours on its contact page.
cards.access_notes: Official hours are 7 a.m.–5 p.m. Sunday–Thursday and 7 a.m.–7 p.m. Friday–Saturday.

cards.title: A public-library stop at 46th
cards.subtitle: Tennyson Street corridor — beside W. 46th Avenue
cards.notes: Use the branch’s computers, meeting spaces, or outdoor book drop, and check its schedule before planning a study or print stop.
cards.short_summary: A public branch with technology, meeting spaces, and branch services.
cards.evidence_claim: Denver Public Library lists Smiley Branch at 4501 W. 46th Avenue and identifies computers, meeting spaces, printing, bike parking, and an outdoor book drop.
cards.source_title: Smiley Branch Library | Denver Public Library
cards.access_notes: The library is open to the public; its official page posts current day-by-day hours.
